confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor (about 1.9x and 1.3x) because direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is least certain: July is high season, below the August festival peak, and a planned Edinburgh visitor levy may or may not be included. GBP-based values assume about 1.33 USD per GBP. The FX observation came from RBA search-result snippets, not from opening the raw F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Benchmarked to UK and Irish cities with strong summer tourism demand (such as York, Bath and Dublin as reference points), with an upward adjustment for Edinburgh's central and Old Town accommodation premium in July.
